answer: In an attestation graph, assign trust from trusted seeds by averaging walks capped at \(k\) steps, so sybils cannot amplify one another indefinitely. For a cluster \(S\), conductance \(\phi(S)=|\partial S|/\mathrm{vol}(S)\) measures its sparse external cut; with limited walk length, only boundary-crossing paths import seed trust, bounding the cluster’s aggregate voting weight by that incoming flow. A harbor of mutually attesting identities thus gains no weight merely by adding pigment-like aliases or marble-hard internal links.
